key_insight: Turbo Harness turns a one-size-fits-all global harness into an instance-adaptive harness by reusing prior optimization artifacts to generate tailored patches for each task.
engineering_relevance: This enables more reliable agent execution across heterogeneous inputs, improving harness design for interactive agents, software engineering, and long-horizon terminal workflows.
method: Recycle outputs from a completed global harness optimization run.
Summarize artifacts into a structured playbook.
Train a harness editor to produce instance-specific harness patches at inference time.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent gains over existing harness optimization baselines across seven benchmarks spanning interactive agent tasks, software engineering, and long-horizon terminal tasks.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and coverage of the original optimization artifacts, so the approach may be less effective when prior runs are sparse or poorly representative.
